response.consequence: Redundant file I/O and parsing on a cold start under concurrent load. The results are identical, so correctness is not affected. The fix is to re-check the cache after Lock().
response.explanation: GetWebAssets reads the cache under RLock, releases it, and then takes the write Lock on a miss. It does not check the cache again once it holds the write lock. If N requests arrive while the cache is empty in non-Dev mode, all N see nil. They then take the lock one at a time, and each re-reads assets-manifest.json and overwrites the cache. The exported signature and return type are unchanged, so I found no API compatibility break.
response.title: No cache re-check after taking the write lock; concurrent cold-start callers each re-read the manifest
